serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: How are you keeping up, Melissa? It wasn’t that long since our talk.
Melissa: I’m fine already. You don’t need to worry.
#Cashier.Face.shocked
You: Sorry, but I’ve got to ask. Is Annalie bothering you? 
#Cashier.Face.normal
Melissa: That was out of nowhere. You surprised me.
You: Well, now that I know what you went through, I thought that her pervy jokes might be inappropriate for you. 
Melissa: Stop it. If I were bothered, I would say something, trust me.
Melissa: Annalie. She reminds me of someone I met a long time ago. 
You: Is it a good memory?
#Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.happy
Melissa: Yes. Yes, it is. 
#Cashier.Face.normal
Melissa: With that out of the way, can we call them back? I don’t want them to get any weird ideas. It would be annoying.
You: You are completely right.
